description: For meeting action item, this checklist records discussion outcome, decision needed, action deliverable, owner, dependency, due date, priority, and success evidence. Its supporting evidence includes source note, linked document, decision rationale, owner acknowledgment, progress updates, and completion proof.

use_case: Use the checklist during meeting decision and action-item control when the meeting action item record must identify meeting purpose, date, facilitator, participants, agenda, referenced documents, and decision forum. Complete the applicable handoff for verified completion, accepted deliverable, unresolved carryover, stakeholder notification, and decision-log update.
